item.title: POINT OF VIEW: Training for high-wage work on waterfront
item.description: THE MARINE TRADES are one of humanity’s oldest activities, and walking through the Northwest School of Wooden Boatbuilding, you can feel the deep roots of the tradition’s history. As the salty sea air mixes with the scent of freshly sanded wood, you can’t help but feel a connection to the rich culture and character inherent in the practice.
